svg.text: ROUND 229 · SPECULATIVE DECODING ROOFLINE CROSSOVER (HIGH-BATCH NEGATIVE SPEEDUP) & EAGLE-3 / PLD FAQ
Speculative Decoding: 26.8 ms High-Batch Collapse vs EAGLE-3 + Dynamic Tree Throttle (3.08 ms, 3.18x)
⛔ Tier 1: Static 64-Node Tree at High Batch (BS=64)
• Speculative decoding ONLY works when target decode is Memory-Bound!
• At BS=64, verifying a 64-node draft tree feeds `64 × 64 = 4,096`
tokens into target GEMMs — crossing H100 Roofline (`~295 FLOP/B`)
into Compute-Bound saturation with 94% wasted draft FLOPs! ✕
BS=64 TPOT: 26.80 ms (1.85x SLOWER Than No Speculation!) ✕
Never Keep Fixed Large Draft Trees Enabled During Traffic Spikes
• Fuses Low/Mid/High target feature layers into 1-layer draft head
• Achieves `τ = 4.65` accepted tokens/step (`3.08 ms` TPOT at BS=1–8)
• Dynamically shrinks draft tree (`64 -> 16 -> 4 -> Off`) as active
batch size approaches the GPU Roofline ridge point (`B × M <= 256`)
BS=1 TPOT: 3.08 ms (3.18x) | BS=64 TPOT: 13.80 ms (Zero Regression) 🏆
Guaranteed Positive Speedup Across Both Low and High Concurrency
